title: Some theoretical aspects of bromine-containing triazine flame retardants
composition: Cotton flannelette, source 4.0 oz/yd2. No conversion or unspecified fabric construction details inferred.
washing_state: as tested after source preparation; washing not reported
TGA_instrument: Du Pont 990 Thermal Analysis system with attached 951 Thermogravimetric Analyzer
TGA_specimen_preparation: Fabric sample 5–10 mg, heated from ambient to about 650 °C in 100% nitrogen. TGA and differentiated DTG normalized to dry weight 1. Pan, flow rate and detailed cutting/conditioning are unreported.
LOI_method: Michigan Chemical Instrument; modified ASTM D2863-70 procedure. Oxygen index is minimum volume concentration sustaining combustion.
LOI_specimen_preparation: The identified cotton flannelette preparation. LOI geometry, replicate count, modification details and uncertainty are not reported.
TG_locator: Original p.2961 methods and rate-maximum definition; pp.2962–2965 sample-specific DTG discussion; Table II p.2965 temperatures at maximum rate of weight loss.
LOI_locator: Original Table II p.2965 Oxygen-index column, same treatment rows; modified oxygen-index procedure p.2961.
conditions_locator: Original pp.2960–2961 compounds, Fabric Treatment, Table I and Fabric Test Methods.
pairing_evidence: The single treatment series Ia–Ie on cotton flannelette is defined in Table I. Table II directly co-tabulates each treatment and control with oxygen index and own fabric DTG peaks. Neat compound thermal peaks are discussed separately and are not used.
source_location: Indexed reproduction of the original published eight-page paper,2959–2966; preparation, methods, Table I/II and peak-definition prose read. Some graph text/paragraph continuation is incomplete; no original PDF bytes or pixel review claimed. DOI identity independently matches Crossref title/author/year/volume/pages.
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Fabric samples of 5–10 mg; TGA and DTG curves for untreated control fabric and treated fabrics.
source_material_form_LOI_raw: Data on Cotton Flannelette Treated With Bromine-Containing Triazines, oxygen-index column.
limitations: Bounded extraction of explicitly defined DTG peak temperatures and measured oxygen indices from the original published Table II. No curve coordinates or neat-compound peaks are substituted. The table header labels residual char at 600 °C but an extracted footnote specifies 530 °C with unresolved row-marker binding; all residues remain source-native only. The Ic residual scalar is not legible in the indexed table. Exact scan endpoint is only about 650 °C, and initial ambient temperature is not numerically assigned. Table I gives compound/DMF/water percentages and separate drying/cure schedules; compound synthesis is referenced to earlier work and is not reconstructed. Washing, test geometry and conditioning not described remain unknown. Earlier Chance/Timpa work on TM-DABT/Ia and cotton controls requires future sample-scoped reuse review; no claim that those observations are independent experiments. FF3-71 char length and HBr combustion-gas measurements are distinct from TG and LOI. Source access is indexed original text, not PDF pixel verification.
treatment_method: Pad cotton flannelette from a 20/60/20 compound/DMF/water percent bath; dry for 5 min at 85 °C. Cure for 3 min at 140 °C.
Tmax1_assignment: First source-listed DTG rate-maximum peak; chronological lower-temperature peak where two are given.
Tmax2_assignment: Second source-listed DTG rate-maximum peak; blank where one is tabulated.
